input.command:
set -a; source /home/roberto/edge/secrets/exa.env; source /home/roberto/edge/secrets/keys.env 2>/dev/null; set +a
echo "=== EXA: testa type=deep ==="
curl -s -X POST https://api.exa.ai/search -H "x-api-key: $EXA_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"OpenTelemetry GenAI agent tool call semantic conventions","type":"deep","numResults":2}' | head -c 600
echo; echo
echo "=== X antigo: bearer do keys.env ==="
curl -s "https://api.twitter.com/2/tweets/search/recent?query=exa%20search&max_results=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $X_BEARER_TOKEN" | head -c 400
input.description: Test exa deep param and old X bearer token
